name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: The biggest movement for Billy Doe Meats is a sharp -85.27% drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days, likely driven by reduced organic search visibility or a listing issue, though the account recorded 540 total GBP actions over the full 28-day window including 39 calls and 87 direction requests. GA4 sessions showed a modest +12.31% week-over-week gain, but with $0 spend across Meta and Google Ads, all traffic remains entirely organic.

performance.verdict: Ads dark 28+ days; organic GBP cliff is the live risk.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — $0 Meta and $0 Google. No ROAS or purchase data exists; ecom performance is unmeasurable until ads restart.

Overdue: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 (Aug 14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live, SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — all past Aug 31 deadline with no completion event recorded.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 6 consecutive days (Aug 31–Sep 5) after averaging ~30/day Aug 22–30; 28-day total 540 actions now at risk.
GA4 sessions 3-day signal (Sep 3–5: 263, 301, 381 avg ~315) vs prior 3 days (Aug 31–Sep 2: 285, 436, 412 avg ~378) — sessions down ~17% short-term despite 7d delta showing +12.31%.
Purchases and revenue show 0 for all 28 days in series; Shopify-to-Meta attribution gap documented, but no ad activity means zero purchase signal to reconcile at all.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing immediately — 6 consecutive zero-action days after averaging 30/day signals suspension or suppression.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for 6 straight days (Aug 31–Sep 5) after averaging ~30/day in the prior week. Check Google Business Profile for suspension notice, ownership conflict, or listing suppression and resolve within 48 hours. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return to ≥15/day by Sep 9. Nacer to assign; Sohib to flag to client.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions 3-day trend (avg ~315) vs prior 3-day avg ~378; re-check Sep 9 before attributing to GBP drop.
suggestions.monday_update: The last 3 days of GA4 sessions (Sep 3–5, avg ~315) are running ~17% below the prior 3-day average of ~378. This may be connected to the GBP blackout but is not yet confirmed. No paid spend is live so organic is the only driver. Re-check on Sep 9 — if sessions remain below 300/day alongside continued GBP zero, escalate as a confirmed organic traffic leak.

suggestions.text: Watch all 5 overdue SOW milestones — no ads can responsibly launch until Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live milestone is cleared.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are past their deadlines with no completion event: Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (Aug 14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails (all Aug 31). Paid spend has been $0 for 28+ days and cannot be responsibly restarted without at minimum the Funnel Test and UTM milestone cleared, or ROAS will be unattributable. Sohib to schedule a milestone status call with Nacer by Sep 9 and confirm which gates are physically cleared.
